WITH filtered_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    t.Bytes,
    t.Milliseconds,
    t.UnitPrice,
    mt.MediaTypeId,
    mt.Name as media_type_name
  FROM Track t
  INNER JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
),
overall_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds) as overall_avg
  FROM filtered_tracks
)
SELECT 
  ft.media_type_name,
  AVG(ft.UnitPrice),
  AVG(ft.Bytes * 1.0 / ft.Milliseconds),
  AVG(ft.Bytes * 1.0 / ft.Milliseconds) / oa.overall_avg
FROM filtered_tracks ft
CROSS JOIN overall_avg_val oa
WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ft.MediaTypeId, ft.media_type_name
ORDER BY ft.media_type_name
